subject.title: Workspaces: add full-bleed apps and guarded gallery installs

question: Should Workspaces ship an operator-configured server-side widget gallery together with a new public SSRF redirect-validation plugin API?
rationale: This creates a permanent distribution feature, configuration contract, Gateway network trust boundary, and public plugin API; implementation quality and tests cannot determine whether OpenClaw should own those surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor Guarded Gallery
options.body: Approve the server-side gallery and public SDK direction after recovery and live-proof blockers are closed.

options.title: Land Full-Bleed Only
options.body: Split out the full-bleed tab layout and defer gallery distribution and SDK expansion.

options.title: Externalize Distribution
options.body: Keep discovery and publishing in ClawHub or another plugin-distribution surface rather than adding a Workspaces-owned gallery contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Guarded Gallery
recommendation.body: Approve the server-side gallery and public SDK direction after recovery and live-proof blockers are closed.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Workspaces product scope, operator configuration, security policy, and permanent public plugin-SDK ownership.
